facts.text: The hotel is directly across from the Light Rail.
facts.excerpt: directly across from the Light Rail, our central hotel offers effortless access to the Phoenix Convention Center, Chase Field, and Mortgage Matchup Center

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of downtown Phoenix's most dynamic neighborhoods.
facts.excerpt: Within walking distance of downtown’s most dynamic neighborhoods

facts.text: Every room has floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic city views.
facts.excerpt: every room features floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic city views and warm, natural light

facts.text: Premium rooms and suites have a marble Heavenly Bath with a soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: Premium rooms and suites feature our expansive marble Heavenly® Bath with soaking tub and custom-designed bathrobes

facts.text: The heated Lapis Pool sits on an outdoor terrace overlooking Downtown Phoenix.
facts.excerpt: Go for a swim in our heated Lapis Pool while soaking up the sun on the outdoor terrace overlooking Downtown Phoenix.

facts.text: The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio is open around the clock and has Peloton bikes.
facts.excerpt: Stay active while on the go with 24/7 access to our WestinWorkout® Fitness Studio

facts.text: Guests can request WestinWORKOUT gear lending kits with Hyperice and Bala recovery and strength gear.
facts.excerpt: Stay active while traveling with WestinWORKOUT® Gear Lending Kits. We've partnered with fitness experts Hyperice & Bala to bring you top recovery and strength gear. Request a kit during your stay!

facts.text: Game Room Parlor Suites have a pool table, board games and a tech-enabled conference table that seats up to eight.
facts.excerpt: Challenge friends or colleagues to a game of pool, dive into classic board games, or set the vibe with a portable speaker. A tech-enabled conference table seats up to eight

facts.text: The Westin Club Lounge offers a hot breakfast buffet and premium food and beverages throughout the day.
facts.excerpt: upgrade your stay to a Club-level room for access to our Club lounge featuring hot breakfast and a premium selection of food and beverages throughout the day

facts.text: Jacy & Dakota's serves breakfast, lunch, dinner and happy hour, with indoor seating and a patio.
facts.excerpt: serving breakfast, lunch, dinner, and happy hour with inviting indoor seating and a vibrant patio designed for gathering and great conversation

facts.text: Arizona State University's downtown campus is one block from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Just one block from The Westin Phoenix Downtown, Arizona State University’s downtown campus and Law School put you at the heart of campus life

facts.text: The Roosevelt Row arts district is less than a mile away, a 9-minute ride on the Light Rail.
facts.excerpt: Roosevelt Row is less than a mile from The Westin Phoenix Downtown and just a 9-minute ride on the Light Rail

facts.text: Sedona is a two-hour drive from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: A two-hour scenic drive from The Westin Phoenix Downtown, Sedona offers red rock vistas, hiking trails, and serene landscapes

facts.text: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is about 3.9 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: PHX is located approximately 3.9 Miles from the hotel.

facts.excerpt: We welcome pets with open arms and a treat at check-in

facts.excerpt: Stretch out in the largest rooms in Downtown Phoenix
